note: Both sets cover the same 13 member, plate and bolt claims with matching values and quotes. Set A, however, attaches unsupported conditions to four claims ('Structure South Elevation - Main' for W8X10, W10X15, HSS4X4X1/4 and L4X4X5/16) and a wrong sheet reference ('S-411 C5' where the sheet is S-511), none of which appear on the page. Set B states the same claims without inventing context, so it is more faithful. Neither set omits an engineering fact the other captures.
remarks: The conditions 'Structure South Elevation - Main' and 'S-411 C5' in Set A look like leakage from another sheet (this page is S-511, SECTION DETAILS). STEEL 11'-4"), though some of these are elevation/level annotations rather than member properties.
